blocks.text: 206 15775 CROYDON DRIVE Grandview Surrey Surrey V3Z 2L6

parts.t: CORNER UNIT 1 BED 1 BATH with 856 SQFT DECK with panoramic views and gorgeous potted trees. Spacious unit with real walnut hardwood engineered floors, crown & window mouldings throughout. Built-in closets in bedroom and nook. BONUS 2 PARKING and STORAGE! This is a SOUGHT AFTER UPSCALE LOCATION in MORGAN CROSSING: shops, restaurants, coffee shops, banking, stores, 3 major groceries, med/dental, Steve Nash gym. Pet friendly with dog park nestled in beautiful grounds. 2 PETS ANY SIZE. Transit at your doorstep. Minutes to Hwy 99, US border, White Rock & Crescent Beach. All that you could need at your fingertips in your oasis.
